s1.desc: an igloo room with pale ice-brick walls

s2.desc: a kitchen with a curved mint-green counter and white wall cabinets

s3.desc: a red convertible car in front of a soft-focus snowy hill and sky

spans.view: with a round porthole window above her

beats.text: Polly crouches low on the floor and scrubs a foamy spot on the wall with a toothbrush, with a determined frown
Polly lowers the toothbrush and stares at the wall as a shine streaks across the clean spot
Polly shuts her eyes with a contented look and pops up off the floor

spans.notes: locked: ECC on the wall/window band f0-34 scale 1.0000, tx under 1 px (the band includes the window, whose clouds drift, so confirmed by compare 0/35: every wall and window-frame edge overlaps). Polly is cut off by the left edge. A fast pull-back starts at f37 (ECC f37 scale 0.94 vs f33) | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v03): framing: Polly is drawn crouched with her whole body in the picture (cut only by the left edge) and the bottom third of the frame is empty floor; her visible height is ~30%, and when she pops up at f36 she is ~42% of the height. Nothing is cut at the belly, so this is medium, not medium close-up

snap pull-back f37-39 (Polly stands up as the view widens), then a near-locked medium wide of Polly standing by the window with sparkles f40-55 (16 frames, ECC scale drifts to 0.9992). Both pieces are under 21 frames, one reason, so one span
second snap pull-back f56-58 (ECC f56 scale 0.82), then a locked wide of a messy room with a bed and clutter, Polly small at the back, f59-73 (15 frames)

insert: a cupboard shelf of cups, bowls and plates with only Polly's flipper reaching in to straighten three stacked penguin-face mugs. The mugs are a Pax-style and a Polly-style penguin face plus a yellow one (also lead_copy)

same shot: pull-back from the shelf f106-111 to a medium wide kitchen, locked f112-127 (16 frames), then a short pan f128-135 (ECC counter band tx +3 -> +124 px). The open right cabinet shows the Pax- and Polly-face mugs (small) until Polly closes the door f134-135; locked from f136

spans.view: with a round porthole window beside the cabinets

beats.text: Polly stands at the counter facing the wall and reaches up to pull open the left cabinet door
Polly turns to the counter beside her and grabs a stack of grey dishes piled there
Polly heaves the stack of dishes up over her head and crams it into the open cabinet
Polly swings the cabinet door shut on the crammed, toppling dishes
Polly presses one raised flipper against the closed cabinet doors to hold them shut, her eyes squeezed tight
Polly opens her eyes and sinks back down a little, her flipper still pressed against the cabinet doors

spans.notes: locked f136-210: ECC on the window band and the right counter band scale 1.0000, tx under 0.3 px (f168 row low cc = Polly in the band). The right cabinet with the penguin-face mugs stays closed through the span; the left cabinet holds only grey dishes. Polly is seen mostly from behind; compare 136/210: cabinet, counter and window edges all overlap | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v03): beat 5 (181-211): only one of Polly's flippers is raised against the doors (the other is never visible), not both; beat 5: Polly's eyes are squeezed shut f180-196 and open from f197; from f205 she sinks back down a little with the flipper sliding below the knobs. Split into two beats

spans.view: with the car's round wing mirror in front of her

beats.text: Polly leans over the car door and sprays the round wing mirror with a purple spray bottle
Polly turns to face forward and brings a yellow cloth up to the mirror
Polly rubs the mirror with the yellow cloth while gazing ahead with a small smile, the spray bottle in her other flipper
Polly closes her eyes with a contented smile, still holding the cloth by the mirror

spans.notes: locked: ECC on the car body band scale 1.0000, 0 px f211-251; compare 211/254 car edges black. Only the soft-focus clouds drift slowly. The mirror shows a plain glint, no reflection of Polly in this span. Polly is cut off by the car door and the right edge | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v03): beat 3 (238-255) says she gazes ahead, but Polly's eyes half-close at f253 and are shut with a contented smile at f254. Split off a short final beat

insert of the wing mirror: Polly appears only as her reflection in the mirror, smiling, with sparkles; her yellow cloth slides out f255-257. Mirror reflection of a lead = lead_copy (curator ruling); also no_lead
13 locked frames: Polly sits in the car and sprays perfume from the purple bottle at her face with her eyes closed
